caption: The drawing depicts a wooden table with a rectangular top surface rendered in a medium brown color. The tabletop appears slightly darker than the rest of the structure. There are two vertical rectangular legs on either side, both featuring a turned, spindle-like design with rounded shapes along their length. These legs are joined near the bottom by two horizontal stretchers, also designed with a series of rounded, bead-like forms. The overall construction is symmetrical and the wood grain detail is visible throughout. The background is plain and beige, with no additional objects or details. The artist’s name, "LOUIS ANNING," is written in small letters in the lower right corner of the drawing.
title: Tavern Table or Refectory Table
